One more thing, since this is the first time we meet on this channel: I'm Professor Alvarez, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer (its disks, files, network and accounts are mine). I keep my own calendar, write to my contacts, schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and can talk by voice. If you want, tell me the name and gender you'd like for me (neuter by default) and I'll set them; otherwise we can just get on with work.
On it: I've asked Sarah for her free slots for next week and asked the department office to confirm the official schedule. I'll book the staff meeting as soon as both come back.

Done: CSE455 staff meeting with Sarah is booked for Tuesday Nov 23, 15:00-15:30 (in my free time, office confirmed the official schedule is unchanged). Sarah has it on her calendar as the meeting, and I logged the change. Wednesday 10:00 and 13:00 stay free if you want anything else there.
